verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the documented launch token, which is limited to one non-interactive command such as a one-time remote bootstrap and is used to connect a remote host. That is a narrowly scoped, single-use credential, but it is for daemon bootstrap rather than general agent API access. Otherwise, the docs leave credential scoping to whichever host the user picks to run the agent. Missing for 10: issuing API keys or tokens for agents with configurable permission scopes, least-privilege role or resource restrictions, revocation and expiry controls, and independent corroboration.
